meta.description: Agent-safe API and bounded Midjourney browser image generation for content creation workflows.
meta.author: brandonz@heritagehill.co
meta.boundary: Canonical image-generation stack. Midjourney support is limited to dedicated-profile login, idempotent prompt submission, bounded reference uploads from RUDI input/output roots, authenticated session checks, and requester-triggered export of job variations. No arbitrary navigation, selectors, likes, follows, deletes, edits, billing, or account management.
meta.mcpSafety: Midjourney browser state remains in a dedicated local RUDI profile and is never returned over MCP. Generation requires a caller-provided request_id; ambiguous prior submissions fail closed. Reference uploads reject URLs, traversal, symlinks, non-images, files over 10 MB, and paths outside RUDI input/output roots; content digests participate in idempotency. Job IDs, variation indexes, UI controls, and downloaded artifacts are validated and fail closed.
